body:
1. (#820) In plugins/adlc-cursor/command/adlc-ticket.md and plugins/adlc-cursor/command/adlc-spec.md, replace bare docs/interrogation-protocol.md references with the GitHub URL (https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/blob/main/docs/interrogation-protocol.md) and mark .adlc/lessons/interrogation-template.md explicitly optional (when present).
2. (#850) In plugins/adlc-codex/skills/adlc-spec/SKILL.md, document the adlc gate-manifest record spec-approval --ticket <id> --files <spec.md> --data '{...}' step with the interrogation payload shape that adlc run p1 requires.
3. Add regression assertions in plugins/adlc-cursor/test/packaging.test.mjs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/packaging.test.mjs`

title: Fix adlc-cursor interrogation-protocol links and add spec-approval step to adlc-codex adlc-spec (#820, #850)
